description: List available voices for speech and voice tools. Returns built-in preset voices plus the user's own custom voices. Each voice has an `id`; pass it as `voice` to the audio models (via generate_audio) to select the speaking voice. Use the preview_url to hear a sample. Paginate with the returned next_cursor.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a previous list_voices result).

usable_for.description: Only voices the named tool accepts.

name: list_voices
title: List the voices this account can speak with
